title: German strings for the contact feature and the configEdit action rows
detail: Adds the German copy for the contact feature (screens, panels, fields, delivery status and notification labels), the configEdit action hint `kumiko.configEdit.action.saveFirst` and the masked write-only secret row (`kumiko.field.writeOnly.maskedSet`, `kumiko.field.writeOnly.replace`). Apps that mount contact and this locale package need no further translation work.

title: German strings for the provider choice and the in-app plan switch
detail: Adds billing-foundation planSwitch.*, plans.providerChoice, plans.planSwitchRequested and the providerNotOffered and providerRequired errors.

title: Translations for the default-filter empty state
detail: kumiko.list.empty.defaultFiltered and kumiko.list.empty.showAll are translated in de, es, fr and it.

title: One English reference catalog for all locale packages
detail: The completeness checks of es, fr and it run in the use-all-bundled i18n parity test against the single English catalog in locale-de; the harvest script writes only that file. New keys errors.validation.invalid_format.{email,url,date,datetime,uuid} in all locales.

title: errors.demoReadOnly translated
detail: The read-only demo error has German copy in the informal and formal catalogs.

title: German text for discarding a template draft
error texts for template meta and placeholder validation in German and Spanish
detail: The locale packages carry the new templateResolver.errors keys (invalid meta, unknown and missing placeholders, mail layout format, collection kind not allowed); renderer-web's formatMoney delegates to headless and the create-kumiko-app feature manifest is refreshed.

title: German strings for the file list widget and embedded list accessibility
detail: Adds kumiko.field.file-list.add, empty, move-down and move-up, kumiko.field.file-upload.attached, change, failed, remove and upload, plus kumiko.field.embedded-list.actions and cell-label.

title: Billing consent and cancel dialogs use "du"
detail: `billing-foundation.consent.*`, `billing-foundation.cancel.*`, `billing-foundation.errors.consentTextOutdated` and `billing-foundation.errors.termsUnavailable` switch from "Sie" to "du", matching the `billing-foundation.plans.*` keys. The formal bundle (`address: "formal"`) keeps the "Sie" wording through `localeDeFormalOverrides`.

title: German strings for the billing consent and cancel-contract dialogs
detail: Adds the `billing-foundation.consent.*`, `billing-foundation.cancel.*`, `billing-foundation.errors.consentTextOutdated` and `billing-foundation.errors.termsUnavailable` keys in formal German.

title: German copy for the jobs invalid-payload error
detail: Adds the German copy for `jobs.errors.invalidPayload`, shown when a manual job trigger gets a broken or non-object JSON payload.

title: German strings cover every registered key and call the audit log "Ereignisprotokoll" everywhere
detail: The new i18n-parity test in `use-all-bundled` harvests the English copy from the real registrations (feature translations, client plugins, renderer defaults, mail templates) and fails with `key -> locale` when `locale-de` or `locale-es` lacks a key or an en-catalog drifts. This added the missing German and Spanish copy for billing plans, the privacy-center status field and many more keys, and removed 110 translation keys no feature registers any more. German uses "Ereignisprotokoll" for the audit log everywhere. `userDataRights.privacyCenter.restriction.dialogTitle` and `.deletion.dialogTitle` are registered in English by the feature.

title: locale-de and locale-es drop 110 keys that no framework feature registers any more (old custom-screen keys such as audit.log.*, jobs.runs.*, userDataRights.privacyCenter.title)
detail: The new i18n-parity test in `use-all-bundled` harvests the English copy from the real registrations (feature translations, client plugins, renderer defaults, mail templates) and fails with `key -> locale` when `locale-de` or `locale-es` lacks a key or an en-catalog drifts. This added the missing German and Spanish copy for billing plans, the privacy-center status field and many more keys, and removed 110 translation keys no feature registers any more. German uses "Ereignisprotokoll" for the audit log everywhere. `userDataRights.privacyCenter.restriction.dialogTitle` and `.deletion.dialogTitle` are registered in English by the feature.
migration: The framework no longer renders these keys, so framework screens are unaffected. If app code or an app test calls t() with one of them, register that key in the app's own translations or switch to the key the framework screen uses now (for example the screen title key screen:<screen-id>.title, as in screen:audit-log.title).

title: New pager, list, form, wizard and drawer strings
detail: Adds the keys for the pager, list counts, sort label, form changed marker, unsaved counter, "All fields are required.", the on-this-page nav, wizard "Save and close" and "Next: {title}" and the drawer discard dialog.

title: German strings for the new billing-plans cancel-scheduled banner and reactivate label
detail:
Adds German i18n strings for the cancel-scheduled info banner and the
"Reactivate subscription" button label introduced by billing-foundation's
cancel/reactivate change.
